description: Expander for enCORE, sitting immediately to its right, giving each of its eight tracks a row of per-track controls

params.text: Turns fill on for that track, which plays the trigs set to FILL and silences those set to !FILL
Forces every trig on that track to play, whatever their probability says
Silences every trig on that track, whatever their probability says
Biases the dice roll on that track's trigs, -1 for never playing and +1 for always
Sets how many steps that track is rotated by when a rotation is triggered, 1 to 64
Sets how many steps of that track the rotation runs over, 1 to 64
Switches that track's transpose input between a volt per octave and a volt per semitone

inputs.text: A gate here turns fill on for that track and releasing it turns fill off
A gate here forces every trig on that track to play
A gate here silences every trig on that track
Transposes that track's pitch output, a volt per octave or a volt per semitone depending on its switch
-10V to +10V biases the dice roll on that track's trigs, added to the knob
A trigger here rotates that track's trigs to the left by the SHIFT setting
A trigger here rotates that track's trigs to the right by the SHIFT setting
